area_note: Kharif cotton sown area 109.17 lakh ha vs 109.86 a year earlier (Ministry of Agriculture, as of Sep 4, 2026)

policy.t: Import duty: India waived its 11% cotton import duty from June 1, 2026; the waiver has been extended to December 31, 2026 (confirmed Oct 30). The duty returns on January 1 unless extended again.
